correctness.rationale: Detailed balance telescopes the centered Stein solution; the tail-to-p_j ratio is bounded by eventual geometric decay of positive logconcave p. Expanding wDelta g(j) as a linear functional of indicator values yields one positive singleton coefficient and nonpositive others, by monotone adjacent ratios on left and right tails. The local envelope is (G_{j+1}+r_jF_{j-1})/w. The difference from (1-p0)/w is a nonnegative exact sum of ratio deficits; it vanishes at j1, and for j>=2 exactly when r1=...=rj. Bessel p_n and r_j=nu/[j(j+k)] yield its closed constant and strict maximizing index. Finite rational examples corroborate, but analytic argument proves the infinite support assertion.

final_claim: For any strictly positive full-support log-concave pmf p on nonnegative integers, constant birth w>0 and detailed-balance death rate d(j)=wp_{j-1}/p_j, the exact indicator Stein first-difference factor over j>=1 is (1-p0)/w, attained at j=1; the local deficit is sum_{i=0}^{j-1}p_i(r_{i+1}-r_j)/w, and the Bessel specialization is (1-p0)/nu.
